== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Romas 'Lock' Navander (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Romas 'Lock' Navander (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]. The 2013 slip and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>2ad0462225d546a09700efe11a4f30be7188a153</code>.
